findings.evidence: Exact case15 AST with actual persisted object shape throws Cannot read properties of undefined (reading find). Actual saveConversation explicitly omits topics/candidates and keeps bindings separately.
findings.fix: Use actual own conversation offer.topics through authenticated read-only projection, or verified bindings/map lookup; do not change product persistence to satisfy producer.

findings.summary: Visible container does not prove full topic union
findings.evidence: Exact helper returns successfully with visible labels container containing zero labels while required union has two topics. No text/count comparison is performed.
findings.fix: For both actual actors/locales, read exact current offer and compare every rendered offered label/count with full offer topics before accepting; retain no prompt at zero/one acceptance.

findings.summary: No-resurrection claim is untested after Resume
findings.evidence: Exact case returns private_not_resurrected=true with private content visibly restored by Resume. cleared() only ran before Resume.
findings.fix: After actual Resume and fresh UI sync/settled lease observation, assert old private prompt/chat/advice/accept state stays cleared; preserve same actual session/round boundary.

findings.summary: Held metadata can pass stale-private-payload test
findings.evidence: Exact case14 accepts one held metadata response and zero held private prompt responses. Runtime buffers every game GET; actual panel sync starts with /current, so this can stop before requesting private conversation. No held body identity/epoch/prompt check exists.
findings.fix: Target and prove a successful actual selected actor conversation response containing the old private prompt/epoch before clear; buffer only that real response, record safe metadata/hash without private text, then release after newer epoch and verify old prompt/advice/chat cannot return. Keep clock case response hold/error/WS preconditions explicit to distinguish lease expiry from a synchronous transport failure.
